# OverraPrep AI

> AI-powered CBT exam preparation platform for FUTA (Federal University of Technology, Akure) students. Practice past questions, get AI explanations, work with verified tutors, and track mastery toward your exams.

## Pages

- [Home](/website): Product overview, features, testimonials, and FAQ.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Pro plans and token packs.
- [Browse Tutors](/tutors): Discover verified FUTA tutors and their quizzes.
- [Become a Tutor](/apply-tutor): Tutor application and requirements.
- [Courses](/courses): Course directory for FUTA departments and levels.
- [Study Hub](/study-hub): Past questions and study packs grouped by course.
- [Subjects](/subjects): Subject browser across faculties.
- [Theory Prep](/theory): Theory questions and AI-graded answers.
- [Survival Kits](/survival-kits): Curated last-minute prep packs.
- [Strategy](/strategy): Study strategies and exam tactics.
- [AI Tutor](/ai-tutor): Conversational AI tutor for explanations.
- [Community](/community): Student community wall and discussions.
- [Leaderboard](/leaderboard): Weekly student leaderboard.
- [Opportunities](/opportunities): Scholarships, internships, and events.
- [Verify Report Card](/verify): Verify an OverraPrep report card.
- [Install App](/install): Install the OverraPrep PWA on your device.

## Optional

- [Terms](/terms): Terms of service.
